news.h: Regrading 2025 NFL deadline trades: How Gardner, Williams deals look right now
news.d: How do the Sauce Gardner and Quinnen Williams blockbuster trades look one year later? What about the Jakobi Meyers, Rashid Shaheed and Jaelan Phillips deals?

news.h: Can Seahawks' Rashid Shaheed become a complementary WR to Jaxon Smith-Njigba?
news.d: Shaheed was a big part of the Seahawks' Super Bowl run as a returner and earned a new three-year contract. But he has been quiet as a receiver since his trade to Seattle.
